Location: Hyderabad, Pakistan Remote: Yes Willing to relocate: No Technologies: Python, JavaScript, Linux, Telegram/Discord bots (python-telegram-bot, discord.py), web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, Playwright), Excel/Google Sheets automation (openpyxl, Google Sheets API), API integration, Make.com, n8n, Zapier, Airtable, Laravel/Nova, Nginx Résumé/CV: https://vikramlal00990.github.io/vikram-portfolio/ Email: aradhyakumari042@gmail.com

Hi, I'm Vikram, a Python automation developer from Hyderabad, Pakistan (12th-grade Pre-Engineering student). I build Telegram/Discord bots, web scrapers, and Excel/Sheets automation that save businesses hours a day, plus API integrations and Laravel/Linux server work. I also do JavaScript deobfuscation / reverse engineering. I manage my family's wholesale store's inventory systems and import goods from China, so I work on real business workflows, not just tutorials. Looking for remote freelance gigs or part-time work at $15/hr, 2-4 hrs/day. Portfolio: https://vikramlal00990.github.io/vikram-portfolio/ — GitHub: https://github.com/Vikramlal00990 — LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/vikram-lal-sakhija-484170449/
